adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly changes the server-side update contract in Admin::GroupsController#update from reading a nested payload (`payload = params[:group]` with `payload[:alias_level]`, `payload[:visible]`, `payload[:name]`, `payload[:usernames]`) to reading only flat params (`params[:alias_level]`, `params[:visible]`, `params[:name]`) and it drops `usernames` handling entirely, moving membership changes to new `add_members`/`remove_member` endpoints. This is verifiable in `app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb` and mirrored by the JS model `Group#asJSON` now returning flat keys. That means an older client still sending `{group: {...}}` would be ignored and `group.save` would still return success (200), causing a silent no-op. It’s a backward-compatibility/API contract concern rather than an intrinsic defect for the updated client in this PR.
